name: Ostervald
statement: This Bible is in the Public Domain.

evidence.quote: French: Ostervald (1996 revision) PRÉFACE DE L'ÉDITION DE 1996 … This Bible is in the Public Domain.

verification.note: A 1996 revision of Ostervald's text. Only a distributor calls it public domain; no release by the revisers or the publisher was found, and a 1996 revision is protected unless its makers released it.
